QuestInfo.name: Truths Too Hard to Speak
QuestInfo.0: The girl says she remembers burying something important underneath the maple tree, and starts digging. Opening her old #btime capsule#k, she becomes distraught and deeply confused to discover that its contents have aged significantly. Upon learning the truth, things only go downhill from there.
